On the 190 x 120 x 16 mm plate, add and fuse two cylindrical bosses of diameter 24 mm and height 20 mm at centers (55,60) and (135,60), starting on Z=16. Cut diameter 8 mm vertical through holes through both bosses and the base. Cut a through obround center slot centered at (95,60), length 62 mm along X and width 18 mm. Cut four corner through holes of diameter 8 mm at (18,18), (172,18), (18,102), and (172,102). Cut two shallow top pockets in the base: X=36..74, Y=20..40, Z=11..16 and X=116..154, Y=80..100, Z=11..16. Export /home/user/Desktop/freecad_task-19_output.step. [Software] To use FreeCAD, run `freecad` from a terminal (use the full executable path if it is not on PATH). On this machine, use `/usr/lib/freecad/bin/freecadcmd-python3` for the FreeCAD command-line work in this task when working on `freecad_task-19_input.step`.
